items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My good friend Oliver Nelson, he died.

ctx.x: we joined his class. I think he was teaching at Bennett [Bennington] College up in Vermont then – a girls college. I think it was a girls college. He used to come home on the weekends, Saturday and Sunday. So we studied with him. I think we had just – only two sessions. Then it fell apart. It fell apart somehow, but I wanted to keep going. So I went to study with him privately. I started studying with him privately. Every Sunday morning I’d go to his house over in Brooklyn for an hour. I think I had about three…
